item.title: Attorney General Ellison wins order preventing power company from disconnecting consumer with life-sustaining medical equipment
item.description:
Publication Date: May 15, 2026

Minnesota law requires energy providers to continue service to customers with life-sustaining medical equipment that requires power

item.title: AG Ellison, Rep. Norris, Sen. Johnson Stewart’s fraud-fighting bill passes Minnesota House of Representatives with strong bipartisan support
item.description:
Publication Date: May 17, 2026

Medical Assistance Protection Act (MAP Act) passes House on vote of 118 to 16. Legislation expands the size of Ellison’s Medicaid Fraud Control Unit (MFCU), strengthens state Medical Assistance fraud law, and expands MFCU’s investigative power.

https://www.ag.state.mn.us/Office/Communications/2026/05/17_MAP-Act.asp
